evaluation_protocol.split_discipline: Official test splits are held out from fitting, calibration and threshold selection. Segmenter preprocessing and protocol arms were compared on the official test split during development, so the selected arm is a development choice rather than a pristine one-shot holdout. The steel and Kolektor calibration/early-stopping splits also overlap; that limitation is disclosed and quantified by the protocol ablation.
evaluation_protocol.quality_gate: Evaluation applies the same acquisition gate as the station before the decision. A failed gate returns REVIEW and never executes the models.
evaluation_protocol.decision: Anomaly profiles use split-conformal tail p-values; FAIL at alpha 0.05, REVIEW at alpha 0.10, with a missing or non-finite channel failing closed. The steel profile uses a recall-targeted screening rule with a review threshold below FAIL. A dual known-plus-anomaly rule was evaluated in the channel ablation and rejected; deployed profiles use one channel. Localisation thresholds are fitted on normal calibration maps, and steel class report thresholds are fitted on matched development boxes.

steel_surface.protocol: NEU-DET official train/validation. The screening threshold is fit on a 10% development split of official train (held out from gradient updates and also used for early stopping). The official validation split is the reported test set. NEU-DET contains defect images only, so steel is evaluated as a recall-targeted screening task.

commutator.protocol: KolektorSDD official JIM-2019 three-fold split by physical part; fold 0 is the operating point. A 15% physical-part holdout supplies both early-stopping and calibration scores; this shared split is a disclosed selection limitation. Portrait 384x1024 preprocessing is used.

textile_carpet.protocol: MVTec AD official train/test; fit on 80% of train/good, calibrate on a disjoint 20%, report on the official test split.

segmenter_protocol.protocol: Controlled fold-0 and three-fold segmenter preprocessing/split experiments. All metrics use the official test split at 512x1408. The portrait-current arm is selected because its deployed fold-0 operating point is better; the nested and fixed-budget arms are retained as negative protocol results. The shared validation/calibration split remains a disclosed limitation.
